senses.gloss:
ind.
An auspicious and inceptive particle; it serves to introduce a remark, a question, an affirmation, &c. and corresponds to,
1 After.
2 And.
3 Now, (inceptive or premising.)
4 What, (interrogatively.)
5 All, (comprehensively.)
6 Therefore, thus, further, moreover. &c. It also implies doubt or command, and is frequently redundant.
E.
अर्थ to ask, ड affix, and र is dropped, also अथो.

ind.
A particle of assent, how else, what else, assuredly.

m. (-णः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
अथर्व्व the name of a Veda, and ण aff.

m. (-णः)
1 A family priest.
2 A Brahman versed in the Atharvan Veda.
n. (-णं)
1 A collection of prayers, &c. delivered by ATHARVAN, a sage.
2 A private apartment in which, after a sacrifice, the sacrificer receives absolution from the officiating Brahman.
E.
अथर्व्वण a Veda, and अण् aff.

m. (-र्व्वा)
1 A Brahman.
2 A name of VASIṢṬHA.
n. (-र्व्व)
The name of the fourth Veda.
E.
अथ an auspicious particle, ऋ to go, and वनिप् aff.

m. (-णिः)
1 A Brahman versed in the Atharva Veda.
2 A family priest.
E.
अथर्व्व the Veda, and णि aff.

ind.
Or.
E.
अथ, and वा sometimes.

m. (-कः)
A Brahman who has studied the Atharva Veda.
E.
अथर्व्वण and ठक् aff.
